purpose: Pin Python runtime, build-tool, model, FFmpeg, and installer hashes for reproducible qualification. Fields marked requires_qualified_endpoint must be completed by IT on a managed clean-machine Windows endpoint before QG-02 can pass.

python_runtime.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: IT must record the SHA-256 of the approved Python redistributable installer (python.org, WinPython, or corporate-approved source) used on the managed endpoint.

pip.note: Version used during transitive-dep enumeration on 2026-07-30. Pin the pip version used in the wheelhouse build step.

setuptools.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: record the setuptools version used in the wheelhouse build.

wix_toolset.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: record WiX version used to produce the installer, per ADR-005 recommendation.

application_packages.note: Package hashes must be verified by running `pip download --no-deps` on the approved endpoint and checking each wheel against PyPI's published hash. Do not substitute hashes from untrusted sources.

section_1_web_runtime.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: wheel_sha256 fields must be populated by IT during wheelhouse generation.

packages.name: torch
packages.note: Must use organization-approved CPU/GPU variant, not default PyPI wheel.

section_2_ml_runtime.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: all hashes in this section require endpoint verification.

ffmpeg.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: IT must select an approved patched FFmpeg build, verify the binary SHA-256, and record the source. The binary must be placed at the declared location and the hash verified at install time.

whisper_model.note: requires_qualified_endpoint: IT must select the approved Whisper model variant, record the model file SHA-256 and download source, and verify the hash at install time. The model must not be downloaded from the internet after pilot deployment.

application_source.note: Populate these fields by running scripts/install/Measure-HashManifest.ps1 on the candidate revision before submitting to IT for packaging.
